text_block_list.text:
We have finally reached the classic year. 
Speaking of Stay Gold ——

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
——Hey, have you tried out the steak yet? 
They grill it right in front of you, it's 
some good stuff.

We were at the Mejiro family house as 
Meijiro Mcqueen invited us for the New 
Year's gathering.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well unfortunately for you, "same-old" is 
all I've got in me.
choice_data_list: You're the same as ever, no matter...
You're always your usual self no m...

text_block_list.text: Miss Stego～

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Here is to a wonderful new year. I look 
forward to working with you again this 
year～

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Oh～ Bright and Dober, happy New Year.

Accompanying Meijiro Bright was Meijiro 
Dober. Just like Meijiro Bright,
she is in 
the same generation as Stay Gold ——

She is a horsegirl who took upon the
Tiara 
route, aiming for the Oka Sho, the Oaks 
and the Shuka Sho, which is why there are 
only few chances to compete with her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I heard that you and McQueen were going 
through some fine-tuning in your
training, 
and that it was going really well.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hahahah, frankly I'm only getting tossed around by her training regime everyday, but ——

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, my outlook is now looking 
a lot better.
So I guess it's "going well" 
in that way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I have also been seeing to my own final 
adjustments in training for my upcoming 
spring races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I am most definitely looking forward to 
facing against you in the Classics, Miss 
Stego.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hahah, now that's an honor.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely find a way to reach
it…… 
The Satsuki Sho.

After the pleasant chat with Meijiro 
Bright and Meijiro Dober, Stay Gold and I 
were enjoying the food and ——

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Now then,
since my tummy is feeling happy, 
should we get going soon～
choice_data_list: Eh? We haven't even said hi to McQueen

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
We'll see her at training anyway right?
We 
can say our greetings then, today is 
moreso ——
choice_data_list: Wait, but I haven't even seen McQu...

text_block_list.text:
——I had a feeling that you would pull an 
excuse like that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Goodness. If I had not come looking for 
you myself, to think that you would have 
actually headed off.

text_block_list.name: $(scale 55)Elegant C...
text_block_list.text:
A Happy New Year to you, Miss Stego. I am 
looking forward to working with you once 
more this year.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
happy New Year. You really helped us 
out a bunch last year, so thank you for 
that.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Also, the food was really good, McQueen. 
Especially the meat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hearing your satisfaction is greatly 
appreciated,
however may I request you two 
remain for a while longer?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hanging in one place is not really my 
thing. I was thinking of wandering around 
somewhere afterwards ——

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: …That's right. You guys should come along too. A chance like this doesn't come all that often after all, let's go have some fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Again with the spontaneous ——

text_block_list.name: $(scale 55)Elegant C...
text_block_list.text: …Uhm, Miss McQueen, if you would allow me, I would like to take upon Miss Stego's offer.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ooh, this is good. It's 3 v 1 then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
…I understand.
As I have nothing scheduled 
after this event, I will partake in this 
little escapade. However ——
choice_data_list: (Wait, was I included in the count...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Please do escort us properly, as this was 
your proposal.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Got it. Well then Trainer, I'll leave the 
destination to you.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
It'd be more interesting if you picked
it. 
It's all you now.

An unreasonable request was suddenly 
placed on my shoulders. I want to respond 
with a place that could match their
fancy. 
All I could come up with was ——
choice_data_list: T-Then, we go on a stroll…?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haha, I also think it's a good time to go for a stroll. Alright, let's go.
choice_data_list: Wanna head to the arcade or someth...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: W-Where are you even thinking of going?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
If you've decided where you're going,
then 
it's not a stroll anymore now is it.
We're 
just chilling, just chilling.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Just where in tarnation are we!?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Gee, I wonder now. Well regardless, we've got a great scenery don't we.

text_block_list.name: $(scale 55)Elegant C...
text_block_list.text: ……It's a beautiful sunset………

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
That's right. It's as if the horizon has 
been lit on fire.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Haa…… It is not like I mind all that much. Stay Gold is just this type of person…

…We gazed at the beautiful sunset 
together, but afterwards, we were 
genuinely dazed by how we manged to end
up 
in the middle of nowhere —

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Tea time huh… Good opportunity actually, 
there was a store I wanted to try out.

text_block_list.name: $(scale 55)Elegant C...
text_block_list.text:
For a store to interest Miss Stego… I am 
very curious what it would look like!
choice_data_list: Then shall we go check it out?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
…………I must say I feel an incredibly 
unpleasant sensation tingling up my tail.

text_block_list.name: Zombie Cafe Waiter
text_block_list.text: AvAvAvAvAvA!! (Thank you for your order!) VaVaVaa! (Please wait a moment!)

text_block_list.name: $(scale 75)Zombie Ca...
text_block_list.text: Va～a～a～a～!!! (Thank you very much!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hiee……! W-W-What is even happening!? Why are we at such a spooky dooky place!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hahahaha! Your startled reaction is so good! Also, I have no idea what you're even saying!!

text_block_list.name: $(scale 55)Elegant C...
text_block_list.text:
Now that I have taken a closer look, the 
interior is incredibly intricate. I think 
it is absolutely wonderful…!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ohh goodness, why are all of you enjoying this as if it was a normal tea party!?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Now now, no need to get all puffed up. I'm sure the sweets we ordered will taste great, so look forward to them alright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You do have a point…!? If you dare lie, 
then there will be no pardons for you 
alright…!

Afterwards, despite the spooky-dooky 
interior, the sweets turned out to be 
absolutely delectable, and was enjoyed to 
everyone's satisfaction——

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Checking out the arcade huh. Well, these 
places are good from time to time.

text_block_list.name: $(scale 55)Elegant C...
text_block_list.text:
Are we going to play on the coin operated 
game machines? I have never tried them 
before so I am very interested…!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Is that so… Well then, shall we go discover and enjoy the unknown together, Missy?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ——Hoi, Hoi and Hoi.

text_block_list.name: $(scale 55)Elegant C...
text_block_list.text:
Miss Stego, you are incredibly skilled…! 
All your bullets hit so very accurately…!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: P-Please do not come any closer! Ahhh, my bullets…!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Alright, leave it to me. ——Right there.
choice_data_list: Ohh, you got the weak spot in one ...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank you very much… You saved me out 
there.
choice_data_list: Whoa, right in the weak spot in on...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hm～ I think I'm going to rest for a bit. You've got this in the bag, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wai— Is this not terrible timing!? Would 
you at least finish th——

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Only if you express your pleas, will I 
come help you out. Now then,
what shall it 
be?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ah, so this was your intention from the very beginning I see…! Aah! There are just too many enemies!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Good luck～ Mc～Queen.

Just like that,
we enjoyed a rowdy session 
at the arcade.
